correctness.rationale: Reflection averaging reduces the unrestricted lower bound to a single midpoint coefficient q. Two explicit unit-Lipschitz source potentials force norm >=max(2L|q|/h,|L-2(L-1)q|) and its minimum lambda=L^2/[L+h(L-1)], L=sqrt(1+h^2). The explicit positive simultaneous extension using q=Lh/[2(L+h(L-1))] and ordinary averaging at the other midpoints satisfies all 15 pair inequalities, with the two cross-pairs bounded via a strict radical inequality. Independent unconstrained linear programming over the full set of extension coefficients at five different heights recovered exactly this sharp lambda (not merely optimality among positive maps). The h=0 degenerate limit is excluded.
residual_risks: Computational bounded checks are not proofs for infinite or continuum assertions; critical analytic steps were reconstructed.
